decisions.quote:
Our results do not replicate findings by Ert and colleagues (2016; Study 1) who reported
a positive effect of perceived trustworthiness, but not attractiveness, in a sample of 175 listings.
decisions.reason: The authors explicitly state an overall verdict that their results do not replicate Ert et al. (2016; Study 1), as they found no main effect of trustworthiness, no interaction between trustworthiness and attractiveness, and a positive main effect of attractiveness where the original found none. Agreement with the general conclusion that profile photos matter in online markets does not make the replication outcome mixed.
